review.feedback: Two verification defects block approval despite the passing supplied tests. (1) _manual_case uses find_output to accept the expected dictionary anywhere in an execution response, without requiring terminal success or checking the final response node. Matching intermediate data from a running or failed execution can therefore produce passed evidence and a checkpoint. Require successful completion and verify the designated final output; add regressions covering running/failed executions containing matching intermediate data. (2) verify_remote permits additional options and includeOtherFields parameters without validating their values when omitted from the blueprint. For example, QA Result can acquire includeOtherFields=true and still pass readback verification. Reject unreviewed values or explicitly validate harmless defaults, with a regression for this mismatch. Publishing implementation and live integration remain appropriately deferred.
